item.description:
## What's new
- **A model suggested for your Mac.** Observatory's Models page opens with one model picked for your Mac's memory. A build with a draft model is suggested instead when it was measured clearly quicker. - **Real reply speeds.** Models show speeds measured for writing and for code, with short and long prompts. - **A shorter list.** A model's other builds sit under one line, and each says what it adds. Models are sorted into named categories, and Observatory is grouped into five sections with a next step on Home. - **Your models at a glance.** Under On this Mac, each model shows what it does: - **Chat** opens the chat window on that model. - **The speaker** plays a short voice sample. - **A ⋯ menu** offers Show in Finder, Copy model ID, Details and Open on Hugging Face. - **Move to Trash** is offered only for models Astronomical downloaded, so other apps that share your Hugging Face folder keep working. - **Two Ornith builds are back:** `Ornith-1.5-9B-vision-OptiQ-static-4.5bpw` and `Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-OptiQ-static-5.5bpw` can be downloaded from the app again.
## Fixed
- **Chat opens on the model you chose.** Choosing Chat for a model in Observatory now opens the chat window with that model selected.
## Compatibility
- Every supported model stays available, and your downloaded models, conversations and settings are kept. - Requires macOS 14 or later on a Mac with Apple silicon. - Signed with Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and delivered through a signed update feed.
